about.heading: Three generations on central Illinois rooftops
body: Ed Brannigan started this company in 1987 with one truck and the garage of his house on the north end of Springfield. Nearly forty years later we run eight trucks and employ fourteen people, and the approach has not changed: do good work, charge a fair price, and treat every house like it belongs to your own family.

We are fully licensed and insured in the State of Illinois, and every technician on staff carries NATE certification. We are factory trained on Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Goodman, Rheem and American Standard, so whatever is already in your basement, we can service it.
We have been accredited by the Better Business Bureau with an A+ rating since 2004. Most of our work still comes from people who were recommended by a neighbour.

BBB accredited with an A+ rating since 2004

services.name: Air conditioning repair
services.summary: Fast diagnosis and repair for every major brand of central air conditioner, with the common parts already on the truck.
description: When your air conditioning quits in an Illinois July, waiting three days is not an option. We diagnose the fault, tell you what it costs, and in most cases have it repaired the same day.
Our trucks carry the parts that fail most often — capacitors, contactors, fan motors, thermostats — so the majority of repairs are finished on the first visit rather than turning into a return trip.

We work on every major brand of central air conditioning. If your system is old enough that repair no longer makes financial sense, we will say so and show you the numbers rather than quietly replacing parts.
features: Common parts stocked on every truck

services.name: Furnace repair & replacement
services.summary: Emergency no-heat callouts and planned high-efficiency furnace replacement, with financing available on new equipment.
description: No heat is an emergency, and we treat it as one. Emergency calls are dispatched to an on-call technician immediately, 24 hours a day, including holidays.
For planned work, we size the replacement properly for your house rather than fitting whatever is on the van. An oversized furnace short-cycles, costs more to run and wears out sooner.
Financing is available on approved credit with terms up to sixty months on qualifying new system installations.
features: Financing up to 60 months on approved credit

services.name: Heat pump installation
services.summary: Energy-efficient heat pump systems sized correctly for your home, including ductless mini-split installation.
description: Heat pumps have come a long way in cold climates, and for the right house they will cut running costs substantially compared with older equipment.
We size and install full heat pump systems as well as ductless mini-splits, which are a practical answer for additions, converted garages, sun rooms and any space your ductwork never reached.
features: Full system and ductless mini-split installation
Sizing based on your actual house

services.name: Preventive maintenance plans
services.summary: Twice-yearly tune-ups that keep your equipment under warranty and catch small problems before they become expensive ones.
description: Most manufacturers require documented annual servicing to keep a warranty valid. Our maintenance plans cover two visits a year — the furnace before winter, the air conditioning in spring.
The visits are as much about catching the cheap problems early as about efficiency. A worn capacitor found in October is an inexpensive part; the same failure in January is an emergency callout.

services.name: Indoor air quality
services.summary: Whole-home humidifiers, air purifiers, UV lamps and duct cleaning to help with allergies and household dust.
description: If your house is dusty year-round, or someone in it struggles through allergy season, the heating and cooling system is usually part of the story.
We fit whole-home humidifiers, air purifiers and UV lamps, and clean duct systems that have not been touched in years. These work on the air in the whole house, not one room at a time.

services.name: Commercial HVAC
services.summary: Rooftop units, service contracts and planned replacement for small commercial buildings around Springfield.
description: We look after rooftop units and light commercial systems for small businesses across the Springfield area — offices, shops, restaurants and workshops.
Service contracts mean the equipment gets checked on a schedule instead of when it fails, and planned replacement lets you budget for a new unit rather than finding the money in an emergency.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency service?
faqs.answer: Yes. We answer the phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays. Emergency calls are dispatched to an on-call technician immediately.

faqs.question: How often should I have my furnace serviced?
faqs.answer: Once a year, ideally in early autumn before the first cold snap. Air conditioners should be serviced each spring.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing on new equipment?
faqs.answer: We do. Financing is available on approved credit with terms up to sixty months on qualifying new system installations.

faqs.question: What brands do you service?
faqs.answer: All of them. Our technicians are factory trained on Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Goodman, Rheem and American Standard equipment.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: Springfield, Chatham, Rochester, Sherman, Riverton, Auburn and Pawnee.
